unit_statements_verbatim: The requirement for the degree is 128 units.

## Composition/Writing Requirement

---

- WRIT 150 Writing and Critical Reasoning–Thematic Approaches Units: 4
- WRIT 340 Advanced Writing and Critical Engagement Units: 4
- (4 units required)

## General Education

---

- General Education [*] Units: 20

## Pre-Major Requirements

---

### Math Requirement

---

- MATH 125g Calculus I Units: 4
-
- MATH 126g Calculus II Units: 4 or
- MATH 129 Calculus II for Engineers and Scientists Units: 4
-
- MATH 225 Linear Algebra and Linear Differential Equations Units: 4
-
- MATH 226g Calculus III Units: 4 or
- MATH 229 Calculus III for Engineers and Scientists Units: 4

### Physics Requirement

---

- PHYS 151Lg Fundamentals of Physics I: Mechanics, Oscillations and Waves Units: 4
- PHYS 152L Fundamentals of Physics II: Electricity and Magnetism Units: 4

### Biology Elective

---

- BISC 103Lgx General Biology for the Environment and Life Units: 4 or
- BISC 104Lgx How the Body Works Units: 4 or
- BISC 230Lgx The Biology of the Brain Units: 4 or
- HBIO 205Lgx The Science of Sport Units: 4

### Chemistry Elective

---

- CHEM 105aLg General Chemistry Units: 4 or
- CHEM 115aLg Advanced General Chemistry Units: 4 or
- MASC 110L Materials Science Units: 4

## Major Requirements

---

### Engineering Requirement

---

- ENGR 102 Viterbi First-Year Academy Units: 2

### Industrial and Systems Engineering Requirement

---

- ISE 105 Introduction to Industrial and Systems Engineering Units: 2
- ISE 150 Solving Engineering Problems using Python Units: 4
- ISE 220 Foundations of Probability Modeling Units: 4
- ISE 225 Foundations of Data Analysis Units: 4
- ISE 315L Engineering Project Management Units: 4
- ISE 330 Optimization Units: 4
- ISE 350 Principles and Practices of Systems Engineering Units: 4
- ISE 370L Human Factors in Work and Systems Design Units: 4
- ISE 382 Database Systems: Storage and Retrieval using SQL Units: 4
- ISE 410 Planning and Scheduling for Production and Supply Chains Units: 4
- ISE 435L Discrete Systems Simulation Units: 4
- ISE 440 Socio-Technical Systems and Work Organizations Units: 4
- ISE 495ax Senior Design Project Units: 2
- ISE 495bx Senior Design Project Units: 2

## Major Electives

---

- ISE Approved Electives Units: 8
- Free electives Units: 8

## Total units: 128

---

[*]GE Category D is fulfilled by Biology Elective

GE Category E is fulfilled by PHYS 151 or CHEM 105a .

notes.text: The Epstein Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering offers a Bachelor of Science degree in Industrial and Systems Engineering.
notes.source_line: The Epstein Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering offers a Bachelor of Science degree in Industrial and Systems Engineering.

notes.text: The requirement for the degree is 128 units. A cumulative grade point average of C (2.0) is required for all upper division courses applied toward the major, regardless of the department in which the courses are taken. See the common requirements for undergraduate degrees.
